header: Delete an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain
content:
Because the movies domain from this tutorial is for test purposes, make sure to delete it when
you're done experimenting to avoid incurring charges.
To delete an OpenSearch Service domain from the console
1.
Sign in to the Amazon OpenSearch Service console.
2.
Under Domains, select the movies domain.
3.
Choose Delete and conﬁrm deletion.
Delete a domain
